name: dumbbell z press
description: A seated overhead press done on the floor with legs straight out. With no back support, it trains the shoulders and demands a strong core.
instructions: Sit on the floor with your legs extended in front of you.
Hold the dumbbells at shoulder height, palms facing forward.
Brace your core and sit tall without leaning back.
Press the weights overhead until your arms are straight.
Lower them back to your shoulders with control.
